Hi Alice / Jared —

Nice to meet you both last week. Per our discovery, the next practical step is a short hands-on working session where we run a small routing + load benchmark and iterate on prompt routing before the full on-site POC. I want to align on a concrete window now so we can lock capacity and share the test harness.

High-level ask: pick two candidate half-day windows (3.5 hours preferred) within the next 10 business days so we can:
- Do a 30–45m prompt review and routing rules walk-through
- Run incremental throughput tests (target 250–500 concurrent tokens/sec aggregate)
- Validate 95th percentile latency SLOs for your 99% tail (target <150ms token latency for short prompts)

Our suggested slots (all PST):
- Tue Nov 18, 09:00–12:30
- Thu Nov 20, 13:00–16:30

Connor will lead the load harness and Marissa will run the prompt review. I can bring the orchestration/runbook and quick fallback plan if we see capacity strain.

Attachments: redwood-load-plan-v2.xlsx (test matrix), test-harness-readme.md (run instructions). Shared Drive with run artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOC-AtlasBench

Please confirm which slot works or propose alternatives. If you have already reserved capacity in your infra, tell us so we can adapt the harness.

Vanessa / Marissa — adding a short technical plan and timeline below so Alice / Jared know what to expect. I'll bring the harness and run the throughput/latency passes.

Proposed 3.5h agenda (Nov 20, 13:00–16:30 PST):
- 13:00–13:30: Introductions, goals, success criteria (Vanessa + Alice)
- 13:30–14:15: Prompt set & routing review (Marissa lead) — confirm prompt families, routing rules, and golden responses
- 14:15–15:15: Throughput run phase 1 (incremental increase to target concurrency) — measure p50/p95/p99
- 15:15–15:30: Break and quick artifact check-in (logs + KV cache snapshots)
- 15:30–16:15: Stress run (validate queuing/backpressure & fallback)
- 16:15–16:30: Wrap, next steps, and handoff (include proposed follow-up POC weeks)

Test specifics:
- Target throughput: start at 100 tok/s, ramp to 400 tok/s in 3 steps.
- Latency SLO target: p95 < 120ms for short prompts; track p99 as escalation metric (aim <150ms).
- Harness: will use our local replay driver + optional Atlas ingress. I will drop a linked readme in the Drive folder and attach the test matrix.

Attachments: redwood-load-plan-v2.xlsx (matrix). I will also upload a condensed run command snippet to the Drive.

Marissa — can you confirm the prompt families you'll bring? Also, Vanessa can you add Vivek on the final invite for SLA thread visibility?

Thanks,
Connor
